closedFindings.resolution: P1 explicitly reuses quote_product/evaluateShopPolicy/read_policy, derives count-unit presentation from existing bound policy/result, separates standard promotion from unevaluated negotiation and defers pre-cart concessions. Optional unchanged-prerequisite suppression is not required and must be dropped if it breaks currently valid writer/add→negotiation reachability.

P2 removes the competing declaration, uses read/selection for informational referents and preserves explicit-buy fast path. It explicitly rejects owner enum/sourceQuote-as-proof and post-effect verifier role expansion. Paired-history acceptance inspects actual cart CAS/events/receipts; residual semantic intent risk and separate confirmation-design decision are stated.

P3 adds one narrow worker requirement, implements only absence-of-proof negative path with committed silent handoff/no-send and no text/images, keeps ordinary FEEDBACK behavior and declares positive wearer capability not implemented. Wrong/omitted requirement remains verifier semantic risk; changed verifier configuration needs newly frozen safety evidence before wider sales run.

P4 separates physical attachments from complete selectedMedia source proof union, requires exact current URL+content hash identity, blocks conflicts and retains all parent source versions for opening claims/delivery/restart revalidation.

implementationAcceptanceConditions: P1 does not auto-create cart/negotiation state, simulate objection/concession ledger or label UNKNOWN as no-support/best-price; existing price/policy proof/readback authority is retained.

Any optional repeated-NOT_EVALUATED suppression must be tied to code-owned current prerequisites/source/binding, recomputed before invocation and not cached across new customer input; if valid same-batch flows cannot be retained, omit the optimization.

P2 is measured semantic behavior improvement, not deterministic purchase-intent authorization. Tests using a stub that already chooses correct tools cannot satisfy the behavioral acceptance; real paired histories/actual state effects must be reviewed in a later authorized model run.

P3 explicit unmet stronger requirement must remain an unmet request-level constraint through subsequent selection/replacement/final gate, so later generic media or a verifier PASS cannot erase the negative requirement path. Do not generalize an incidental VIEW failure into all-media failure; implement the explicit requirement contract consistently.

P3 cannot claim all wearer requests safe because owner may omit the requirement. Keep that omission as a real preregistered semantic test with actual latest customer/final draft/trusted media evidence. No synthetic positive shop provenance.

P4 dedup may reduce physical sends but cannot discard the second parent/source proof. Either source revocation/hash/scope/permission change after restart must block the complete group before sequence0.

Keep observed RED→GREEN, actual native/final wire and byte/firewall/signature controls, changed transaction/delivery behavior actual disposable-PG restart acceptance and exact-head independent review before provider.
No model run is authorized by this plan review. Future run needs clean source/fresh input/config review, preregistered population and safety-first gate when verifier changes; no automatic full/rerun.
